meta.title: 48 Hours in CAT BA (Boat Tour + Driving Around the Island) 🇻🇳
meta.description:
So… you’ve heard of Ha Long Bay right? Crystal clear waters and incredible island scenery which is essentially paradise in a nutshell. Well, what if there was a place that shared the same natural wonder which you can enjoy at a much lower price with less crowds? Welcome to Cat Ba and Lan Ha Bay!

In this video we will run through the perfect 48 hour Cat Bq itinerary that travellers on a budget can enjoy. Over our 2 days in Cat Ba, we enjoy both land and sea as we climb up mountains to view the karst mountains on the main island whilst also taking the time enjoy a boat tour to Lan Ha Bay.

Cat Ba is truly one of the main highlights of Vietnam as is a destination that shouldn’t be missed.

As always, we're backpacking, we're on a budget, but we're trying to do as much as possible. Be part of the journey by hitting subscribe and let’s go island hopping in Cat Ba!

Follow the journey from Singapore to Sapporo on Instagram: https://bit.ly/3IgS21c
